circleTeaser: Kamika Ekadashi tomorrow. A tulsi leaf offered with devotion outweighs every costlier gift.

dpb.confidenceNote: The Shravana Krishna Ekadashi and its tulsi-centred mahatmya are narrated in the Purana; the fasting form is the keeper's choice, as with every Ekadashi.

en.title: Kamika Ekadashi — the complete guide
en.heroSubtitle: The dark-fortnight Ekadashi of Shravana, where a single tulsi leaf is the greatest offering.
en.deck: Why Kamika is called the Ekadashi of the tulsi leaf, the three-day rhythm of the vrat, and the parana that completes it.
en.introHtml: Kamika Ekadashi falls in the dark fortnight of Shravana, in the heart of the monsoon months when Vishnu is said to rest. Its mahatmya makes one point above all others: a single tulsi leaf offered to Hari with devotion outweighs gold, gems and grand yajnas. The vrat follows the gentle three-day rhythm of every Ekadashi — a light evening before, a grain-free day of worship, and a parana the morning after.

blocks.title: Why this vrat
blocks.text: He who offers Hari but one leaf of tulsi on the Kamika day gains what mountains of gold cannot buy — so Krishna told Yudhishthira.

sankalpa.gloss: For the love of Vishnu, I undertake this Kamika Ekadashi vrat. Say it in any language you carry in your heart — no Sanskrit required.

samagri.name: Vishnu image or idol
samagri.note: any form you keep at home

samagri.name: Tulsi leaves
samagri.note: the day's central offering — plucked the day before

steps.title: Eat light the evening before
steps.description: One sattvik meal before sunset, no grains after it.

steps.title: Morning bath and sankalp
steps.description: Bathe, wear clean clothes, sit facing east and take the sankalp with water in your right palm.

steps.title: Puja of Vishnu — tulsi first
steps.description: Offer the tulsi leaf first, then flowers, the diya and bhog. The leaf is the day's whole point; everything else is garnish.
steps.note: day: Ekadashi — 21 Jul. Offer tulsi gathered the day before, never plucked on Ekadashi itself.

steps.title: Keep the fast through the day
steps.description: No grains, rice or lentils for the vrati. Water, fruit and milk as your chosen form allows, with japa whenever the day permits.

steps.title: Read or listen to the Kamika katha
steps.description: The mahatmya Krishna narrates to Yudhishthira. Listening is as complete as reading.

steps.title: Evening diya — deepdaan if you wish
steps.description: Light the evening diya before Vishnu. Many households light an extra lamp — deepdaan — near tulsi or at a temple this night.
steps.note: day: Ekadashi evening — 21 Jul. Deepdaan is a loving regional addition.

dpb.prathaScope: Vaishnava households pan-India — strongest in UP, Bihar and Braj

steps.title: Parana — break the fast
steps.description: On Dwadashi morning, within the parana window, break the fast with a simple grain meal offered first to Vishnu. The vrat is complete.

mantra.meaning: I bow to Bhagavan Vasudeva — the twelve-syllable mantra of Vishnu, open to all.

blocks.title: Choose your fast

fasting.name: Nirjala
fasting.description: No food, no water, through the Ekadashi. Only for the able-bodied and experienced.

fasting.name: Phalahar
fasting.description: Fruit, milk and water through the day. The most widely kept form.

fasting.name: Anna-tyaag
fasting.description: One grain-free sattvik meal in the day. Right for pregnancy, illness, age and first-timers.

blocks.text: The one rule the texts share is the setting aside of grains and rice. Everything beyond that is your choice — devotion, not endurance.

blocks.title: Parana — the window that completes the vrat
blocks.text: The fast is formally broken on Dwadashi morning — 22 July 2026 — after sunrise and before the Dwadashi tithi ends. Break the fast mid-morning within the panchang's parana window for your city, offering the first food to Vishnu. A parana delayed by circumstance, done with devotion, does not undo the vrat.

myths.question: I could not arrange flowers, panchamrit or a proper thali. Is my puja too small?
myths.answer: The Kamika mahatmya exists to answer exactly this: one tulsi leaf, offered with devotion, is declared greater than gold and gems. Simplicity is this Ekadashi's teaching, not its failure.

myths.question: I ate grains by mistake on Ekadashi. Is the vrat destroyed?
myths.answer: No. Complete the day with devotion and do the parana as planned. No text attaches punishment to an honest lapse.

hi.title: कामिका एकादशी — सम्पूर्ण विधि
hi.heroSubtitle: श्रावण कृष्ण एकादशी — जहाँ तुलसी का एक पत्ता सबसे बड़ा अर्पण है।
hi.deck: कामिका को तुलसी-पत्र की एकादशी क्यों कहते हैं, व्रत की तीन-दिवसीय लय, और पारण जो व्रत को पूर्ण करता है।
hi.introHtml: कामिका एकादशी श्रावण के कृष्ण पक्ष में आती है। इसका माहात्म्य एक ही बात सबसे ऊपर रखता है: भक्ति से हरि को अर्पित तुलसी का एक पत्ता स्वर्ण, रत्न और बड़े यज्ञों से भारी है। व्रत हर एकादशी की सहज तीन-दिवसीय लय में चलता है — दशमी की हल्की संध्या, अन्न-रहित एकादशी, और द्वादशी का पारण।
